name: vkosapp
description: VKOS Hub 3.0. CORE e workspaces de clientes na nuvem.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n servidor,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w motor
scripts.checar: npm run checar -w server && npm run checar -w web && npm run checar -w motor
scripts.testar: npm run testar -w server && npm run testar -w web && npm run testar -w motor
